map.由负载求单侧绳张力: Find the single-side rope tension from the load
map.输入被提升负载 F，求理想定滑轮单侧绳张力。: Enter the lifted load F to get the single-side rope tension of an ideal fixed pulley.
map.📖 查看「由负载求单侧绳张力 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the single-side rope tension from the load"
map.理想滑轮 T = F/2（两侧均分）。: For an ideal pulley T = F/2, shared equally by the two sides.
map.定滑轮两侧张力。: Tension on both sides of a fixed pulley.
map.100N 载荷过定滑轮: 100 N load over a fixed pulley
map.理想定滑轮无摩擦，两侧张力均 T=F/2=50N（两侧共承 100N）。: An ideal fixed pulley has no friction, so both sides carry T = F/2 = 50 N and together support the 100 N load.
map.实际有摩擦时两侧不等，须按效率修正。: With real friction the two sides differ and must be corrected for efficiency.
map.静力平衡下两侧张力相等且和为 100N，故各 50N。: In static equilibrium the two tensions are equal and sum to 100 N, so each is 50 N.
map.动滑轮可省力一半，张力=载荷/2 承担。: A movable pulley halves the effort, with the tension carrying load/2.
